words.ex: She takes a shower after work.
I brush my teeth twice a day.
I sleep eight hours every night.

story.title: A Simple Morning
story.text: Sara wakes up early every morning. First, she brushes her teeth and takes a shower. Then she has breakfast with her family. She usually drinks tea and eats bread with cheese. After breakfast, she goes to school by bus. Sara loves mornings because they give her energy for the whole day.
story.q: What does Sara usually drink at breakfast?

grammar.title: الفعل To be (am / is / are)
grammar.explain: نستخدم am مع I، و is مع he / she / it، و are مع you / we / they. ونستخدمه للتعريف بالنفس ووصف الأشخاص والأشياء والحالات.
grammar.q: Choose the correct word: We ___ friends.

words.ex: What is the price of this shirt?
The car is too expensive for me.
I want to buy some bread.
We go to the market on Fridays.
There is a ten percent discount today.
Do you pay by cash or card?
Can I have a bag, please?

story.title: At the Market
story.text: Omar goes to the market with his mother. They want to buy fruit and vegetables. The apples are cheap today, but the oranges are expensive. His mother asks for a discount, and the seller smiles and agrees. They pay in cash and take a receipt. Omar carries the bags home happily.
story.q: Which fruit is expensive today?

grammar.title: المضارع البسيط (Present Simple)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه للعادات والحقائق. نضيف s أو es للفعل مع he / she / it. وللنفي نستخدم don't مع I / you / we / they، و doesn't مع he / she / it.
grammar.q: She ___ to school every day.

words.ex: We arrived at the airport early.
The hotel is near the beach.
I made a reservation for two nights.
We leave at six in the morning.

story.title: The Trip to Istanbul
story.text: Layla and her brother are going on a trip to Istanbul. They arrive at the airport early. They show their passports, check their luggage, and wait for the flight. The journey takes four hours. When they arrive, a taxi takes them to the hotel. Their reservation is for five nights, and Layla cannot wait to explore the city.
story.q: How long is the flight?

grammar.title: الماضي البسيط (Past Simple)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه للأحداث التي انتهت في الماضي. في الأفعال المنتظمة نضيف ed للفعل. وللنفي نستخدم didn't مع الفعل في صورته الأساسية.
grammar.q: Yesterday, we ___ a movie.

words.ex: I am hungry after the game.
He is thirsty, so he drinks water.
My grandmother has a famous recipe.
This curry is too spicy for me.

story.title: Grandma's Soup
story.text: On Friday, Nora visits her grandmother. She is very hungry. Her grandmother cooks a delicious soup with fresh vegetables. The recipe is old, and the main ingredient is lentils. Nora asks for a second bowl because the soup is warm and a little spicy. After dinner, they drink sweet tea together.
story.q: What is the main ingredient of the soup?

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.explain: نستخدم There is مع المفرد وغير المعدود، و There are مع الجمع. وفي السؤال نقدّم is أو are: Is there ...? Are there ...?
examples: There is a book on the table.
There are three apples in the bag.
grammar.q: There ___ many students in the class.

words.ex: He is looking for a new job.
The manager is in his office.
We have a meeting at ten.
My colleague helped me with the report.
She has five years of experience.
I have a job interview tomorrow.
We are working on a big project.
Speaking English is a useful skill.

story.title: A New Job
story.text: Ahmed has a job interview today. He feels nervous, but he has good experience and strong skills. The manager asks him about his last project. Ahmed answers clearly and confidently. At the end, the manager says, 'You start on Monday.' Ahmed is very happy and calls his family. He cannot wait to meet his new colleagues.
story.q: When does Ahmed start work?

grammar.title: أدوات التنكير والتعريف (a / an / the)
grammar.explain: نستخدم a قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت ساكن، و an قبل الكلمات التي تبدأ بصوت متحرك (a, e, i, o, u). ونستخدم the عندما نتحدث عن شيء محدد معروف للطرفين.
examples: She eats an apple every day.
grammar.q: He is ___ engineer.

words.ex: Take this medicine twice a day.
I exercise three times a week.
He stayed home because he was sick.
You need to rest for two days.
I feel pain in my back.

story.title: A Healthy Week
story.text: Khaled felt sick last week. He had a headache and no energy. He visited the doctor, who gave him some medicine and said, 'You need to rest.' After two days, Khaled felt better. Now he follows a healthy diet and exercises every morning. He says that being healthy is the best gift.
story.q: What did the doctor tell Khaled to do?

grammar.title: الفعل can للقدرة
grammar.explain: نستخدم can للتعبير عن القدرة أو الإذن، ونفيه can't. وبعد can نأتي بالفعل في صورته الأساسية بدون to.
grammar.q: I ___ speak English.

words.ex: A good friend is a gift.
It is sunny, so let's go out.
What are you doing this weekend?
I want to invite you to dinner.
We have a plan for Friday.
They enjoy walking by the sea.

story.title: The Weekend Plan
story.text: Huda calls her friend Mona. 'The weather is sunny this weekend,' she says. 'Let's go to the park together!' Mona loves the plan. She invites her cousin too. On Saturday, the three of them visit the park, play games, and enjoy a picnic. They promise to meet again next weekend.
story.q: Where do the friends go on Saturday?

grammar.title: المستقبل البسيط (will)
grammar.explain: نستخدم will مع الفعل في صورته الأساسية للتعبير عن قرارات وتوقعات المستقبل. والنفي will not وتُختصر إلى won't.
grammar.q: Tomorrow, I ___ visit my friend.

words.ex: My mother is cooking in the kitchen.
My bedroom is on the second floor.
The bathroom is next to the kitchen.
We have a small garden behind the house.
The cat is sitting on the roof.
We bought new furniture last week.
They pay the rent on the first of the month.

story.title: Our New House
story.text: Hana and her family moved to a new house last month. The house has a kitchen, three bedrooms, and a small garden. Hana's bedroom has a big window, and she can see the street from it. Their neighbor brought them a cake on the first day. Hana thinks the new house is small but very warm.
story.q: Who brought a cake?

grammar.title: حروف الجر للمكان (in / on / under / next to)
grammar.explain: in تعني داخل شيء، و on تعني فوق سطح وملامسًا له، و under تعني تحت، و next to تعني بجانب.
examples: The keys are in the bag.
The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.
grammar.q: The picture is ___ the wall.

words.ex: My parents live in a small town.
My sister is older than me.
My aunt visits us every Friday.
Her husband works at a hospital.
Many relatives came to the wedding.

story.title: A Family Lunch
story.text: Every Friday, the whole family meets at Grandfather's house. Uncle Ali brings fruit, and Aunt Mariam brings sweets. The cousins play in the garden while the parents talk in the living room. Grandfather sits in his favorite chair and tells old stories. Everyone says that Friday is the best day of the week.
story.q: Where does the family meet?

grammar.title: صفات الملكية (my / your / his / her / our / their)
grammar.explain: نضعها قبل الاسم لتوضح لمن يعود: my لي، your لك، his له، her لها، our لنا، their لهم.
grammar.q: Sara loves ___ grandmother.

words.ex: Take your jacket, it's cold outside.
Can I try on this jacket?

story.title: The Blue Jacket
story.text: Adam wants to buy a new jacket for winter. At the shop, he tries on a blue jacket in size medium. It fits him perfectly, and the color looks great. The seller says the price is fifty dollars. Adam is wearing his old shoes, so he decides to look at new shoes too. He leaves the shop with two bags.
story.q: What size is the jacket?

grammar.title: المضارع المستمر (Present Continuous)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه للأحداث التي تحدث الآن. الصيغة: am / is / are + الفعل مع ing.
examples: I am wearing a new shirt.
grammar.q: Look! The children ___ in the garden.

words.ex: I finish my homework before dinner.
Write the words in your notebook.

story.title: Exam Day
story.text: Yara has an English exam today. Last night, she studied her notes and finished her homework. In the classroom, the teacher gives everyone a paper. Yara reads the questions carefully and writes her answers. She makes one small mistake, but she feels proud. After the exam, she meets her friends and they go home together.
story.q: How many mistakes did Yara make?

grammar.title: أدوات الاستفهام (What / Where / When / Why / How)
grammar.explain: What للسؤال عن الشيء، و Where عن المكان، و When عن الوقت، و Why عن السبب، و How عن الطريقة أو الحال.
grammar.q: ___ is the party? At eight o'clock.

words.ex: I go to work by train.
There is a lot of traffic in the morning.
The train is faster than the bus.

story.title: Stuck in Traffic
story.text: Khalid usually goes to work by car, but today there is a lot of traffic. The road is full, and the cars are moving very slowly. He looks at his watch and sees that he will be late. At the next station, he leaves his car and takes the train, which is faster. He arrives at the office just in time for his meeting.
story.q: How does Khalid finally get to work?

grammar.title: صيغة المقارنة (Comparative)
grammar.explain: للمقارنة بين شيئين نضيف er للكلمات القصيرة (faster)، ونستخدم more مع الكلمات الطويلة (more expensive)، ثم نأتي بكلمة than.
examples: A train is faster than a bus.
This book is more interesting than that one.
My brother is taller than me.
grammar.q: A car is ___ than a bicycle.

words.ex: We swim in the sea every summer.
He listens to music on the bus.
I took this photo with my camera.
I relax by listening to music.

story.title: Free Time
story.text: Lina has many hobbies. In the morning, she reads a book and draws in her notebook. In the afternoon, she takes photos with her camera. On weekends, she swims with her cousins. Lina says hobbies help her relax after a busy week. Her dream is to hold a photo show one day.
story.q: What does Lina do on weekends?

grammar.title: like / love / enjoy + الفعل مع ing
grammar.explain: بعد like و love و enjoy و hate نستخدم الفعل مع ing عندما نتحدث عن الهوايات والأشياء التي نحبها.
grammar.q: He enjoys ___ football.

words.ex: The hospital is near the school.
I need to go to the bank.
Turn left at the traffic light.
The shop is on the right.

story.title: Lost in the City
story.text: Tom is new in the city, and he cannot find the library. He asks a woman on the street. She says, 'Go straight, then turn left at the bank. The library is on the right, next to the hospital.' Tom thanks her and follows the directions. Five minutes later, he finds the library and smiles.
story.q: Where is the library?

grammar.title: فعل الأمر (Imperative)
grammar.explain: نستخدم الفعل في صورته الأساسية لإعطاء تعليمات أو أوامر أو إرشادات. وللنهي نضع Don't قبل الفعل.
grammar.q: ___ the door, please. It's cold.

words.ex: I work on my computer all day.
I want to download this app.
I need to charge my phone.

story.title: A Weak Battery
story.text: Rami is waiting for an important message, but his phone battery is almost empty. He looks for his charger and cannot find it. Finally, he uses his computer to open the website of the company. He reads the message and downloads the file he needs. Later, he charges his phone and sends a reply. Rami learns to charge his phone every night.
story.q: Why is Rami worried?

grammar.title: صيغة التفضيل (Superlative)
grammar.explain: للدلالة على الأعلى في المجموعة نستخدم the مع est (the fastest)، أو the most مع الكلمات الطويلة (the most expensive).
examples: This is the fastest computer in the shop.
She is the tallest girl in the class.
It is the most useful app.
grammar.q: Mount Everest is ___ mountain in the world.

words.ex: Check the calendar for the date.
I will see you next week.
I have an appointment at four.

story.title: A Busy Week
story.text: Maya has a busy week. On Monday, she has a doctor appointment. On Wednesday, she studies for her exam. On Friday, it is her brother's birthday, and the family has dinner at home. Tomorrow is Tuesday, so she checks her calendar again. She promises to rest on the weekend.
story.q: What does Maya have on Monday?

grammar.title: حروف الجر للزمن (at / on / in)
grammar.explain: at مع الساعة (at 5)، و on مع الأيام والتواريخ (on Monday)، و in مع الشهور والسنوات والفصول (in July).
examples: I visit my uncle on Fridays.
grammar.q: My birthday is ___ March.

words.ex: I am happy to see you.
She is nervous about the test.
The kids are excited about the trip.
She felt lonely in the new city.
We were surprised by the news.

story.title: Good News
story.text: Salma feels nervous because she is waiting for her exam results. Her mother says, 'Don't be afraid, you worked hard.' Suddenly, the phone rings, and Salma gets the news: she passed with high marks. She is surprised, then very excited. Her father says he is proud of her. That evening, the whole family celebrates.
story.q: How does Salma feel at the beginning?

grammar.title: ظروف التكرار (always / usually / sometimes / never)
grammar.explain: تدل على عدد مرات حدوث الفعل، وتأتي عادةً قبل الفعل الأساسي: always دائمًا، usually عادةً، sometimes أحيانًا، never أبدًا.
examples: I always drink water in the morning.
grammar.q: She ___ forgets her keys. She is very careful.

words.ex: A lion is a wild animal.
We sat under a big tree.
There are many animals in the forest.
She gave me a red flower.
The sky is full of stars.
We spent a week on a small island.

story.title: A Day in the Forest
story.text: On Saturday, a group of students went to the forest. They walked beside a river and saw many birds in the trees. One student found a beautiful flower near a rock. Later, they climbed a small mountain and looked at the sky. From the top, they could see the sea in the distance. Everyone said it was the best trip of the year.
story.q: What did the students see in the distance?

grammar.title: الجمع في الإنجليزية (Plural Nouns)
grammar.explain: نضيف s لمعظم الأسماء (book / books)، و es بعد s, sh, ch, x (box / boxes). وبعض الأسماء شاذة: man / men، child / children، foot / feet.
grammar.q: There are five ___ in the garden.

words.ex: Can I see the menu, please?
I would like to order a salad.
Could we have the bill, please?
We left a tip for the waiter.
I'll have ice cream for dessert.

story.title: Dinner Out
story.text: Fatima and her husband eat dinner at a small restaurant. The waiter gives them a table near the window and brings the menu. They order chicken, soup, and orange juice. For dessert, they share a piece of cake. When they finish, the husband asks for the bill and leaves a tip. They agree that the food was delicious.
story.q: What do they have for dessert?

grammar.title: some / any / much / many
grammar.explain: some في الإثبات، و any في النفي والسؤال. many مع المعدود (many apples)، و much مع غير المعدود (much water) وغالبًا في النفي والسؤال.
grammar.q: There isn't ___ sugar in the tea.

words.ex: Could you lend me some money?
I found a coin on the street.

story.title: Saving Money
story.text: Hamza wants to buy a laptop, but it costs a lot. He makes a budget and saves some money every month. He doesn't spend it on small things. His brother offers to lend him a little, but Hamza says he prefers to pay with his own money. After six months, he checks his bank account and sees enough money. He buys the laptop proudly.
story.q: What does Hamza want to buy?

grammar.title: المضارع التام (Present Perfect)
grammar.explain: نستخدم have / has + التصريف الثالث للفعل للحديث عن تجربة، أو عن شيء بدأ في الماضي وله أثر الآن.
examples: We have lived here for five years.
grammar.q: He ___ already eaten lunch.

words.ex: We want to win the cup.

story.title: The Final Match
story.text: Today is the final match, and the whole team is excited. The coach tells the players to stay calm and play together. In the first half, the other team scores a goal. In the second half, Omar scores two goals, and his team wins. The players jump with joy and lift the cup. The coach says they won because they practiced hard.
story.q: Who scored two goals?

grammar.title: have to / must للإلزام
grammar.explain: نستخدم must و have to للتعبير عن الواجب. وdon't have to تعني أنه ليس مطلوبًا منك، بينما mustn't تعني أن الفعل ممنوع.
examples: She has to wake up early.
grammar.q: You ___ run in the library. It is forbidden.

words.ex: I will send you an email.

story.title: A Bad Signal
story.text: Basel calls his friend, but the signal is bad. 'I can't hear you,' says Basel. 'Could you repeat that, please?' His friend tries again, but the line is still weak. So Basel sends an email instead. A few minutes later, his friend replies with the information. Basel smiles because the problem is solved.
story.q: What does Basel do when the signal is bad?

grammar.title: الماضي المستمر (Past Continuous)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه لوصف حدث كان مستمرًا في وقت محدد في الماضي. الصيغة: was / were + الفعل مع ing.
examples: I was sleeping when you called.
They were watching TV at eight.
grammar.q: At 9 o'clock last night, we ___ a movie.

words.ex: I clean my room on Sundays.
She washes the dishes after lunch.
He irons his shirt every morning.
I do the laundry on Saturdays.
Washing dishes is my least favorite chore.
Can you help me clean the kitchen?

story.title: Saturday Chores
story.text: Every Saturday, Mona's family cleans the house together. Dad sweeps the floor, and Mom does the laundry. Mona washes the dishes and takes out the trash. Her little brother helps by keeping his toys tidy. After two hours, the house is clean, and they eat a big lunch. Mona says that sharing chores makes the work easy.
story.q: What does Dad do?

grammar.title: النصيحة بـ should / shouldn't
grammar.explain: نستخدم should لإعطاء نصيحة، وshouldn't للنصح بعدم فعل شيء. وبعدهما الفعل في صورته الأساسية.
grammar.q: You look tired. You ___ rest.

words.ex: We have a holiday on Friday.
He gave me a nice gift.
We went to a beautiful wedding.
The room is full of decorations.

story.title: The Surprise Party
story.text: Dina's friends plan a surprise party for her birthday. They put decorations in the living room and hide the gifts. When Dina enters, everyone shouts, 'Happy birthday!' She is surprised and laughs. She blows out the candles and makes a wish. Her cousin says congratulations, and all the guests enjoy the cake.
story.q: What does Dina do with the candles?

grammar.title: الشرط الأول (If + present, will + verb)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه للحديث عن احتمال حقيقي في المستقبل: If + مضارع بسيط، ثم will + الفعل.
examples: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If you study, you will pass.
She will be happy if you call.
grammar.q: If I ___ free tomorrow, I will visit you.

words.ex: Turn off the lights to save electricity.

story.title: Our Planet
story.text: Our planet has a problem: pollution. Cars and factories make the air dirty, and plastic fills the sea. But people can help. Students at Ali's school recycle paper and plastic every week. They also turn off the lights to save electricity. Ali says that small actions protect the environment, and everyone can start today.
story.q: What do the students recycle?

grammar.title: المبني للمجهول (Present Passive)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه عندما يهمنا الحدث أكثر من الفاعل. الصيغة: am / is / are + التصريف الثالث للفعل.
examples: English is spoken all over the world.
The room is cleaned every day.
These bags are made of paper.
grammar.q: Rice ___ in many countries.

words.ex: She has a degree in science.
She wants a career in medicine.
You will succeed if you try.
I want to improve my English.

story.title: A Big Dream
story.text: Nadia is in her last year of school, and she is thinking about her future. She wants to study at the university and become an engineer. Her parents support her dream, and her teacher helps her choose a good subject. Every evening, Nadia studies and improves her English. She believes she will succeed if she works hard.
story.q: What does Nadia want to become?

grammar.title: المستقبل بـ be going to
grammar.explain: نستخدم am / is / are going to + الفعل للحديث عن خطة نويناها، أو عن توقع واضح بناءً على ما نراه.
examples: I am going to study medicine.
She is going to travel next month.
Look at the clouds! It is going to rain.
grammar.q: We ___ going to buy a new car.

words.ex: I read the news every morning.
Which channel is the match on?
I saw an advertisement for shoes.

story.title: Movie Night
story.text: On Friday night, Yusuf and his sister choose a film to watch. They read the news about a popular film on the internet and look at the photos of the actors. They find the film on a TV channel and make some popcorn. The film is long, but they enjoy every minute. At the end, Yusuf says it was the best program of the week.
story.q: What do they make before the film?

grammar.title: أسماء الموصول (who / which / that)
grammar.explain: نستخدم who للأشخاص، و which للأشياء والحيوانات، و that للاثنين معًا، لربط جملة بالاسم الذي قبلها.
examples: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
This is the book which I bought.
The film that we saw was great.
grammar.q: The girl ___ sits next to me is my cousin.

words.ex: An honest person tells the truth.
He is too shy to speak.
He is generous with his time.

story.title: The Brave Boy
story.text: Last winter, a small cat was stuck in a high tree near Bilal's house. Everyone was afraid to climb because the tree was old. Bilal was brave and also clever. He took a ladder and climbed slowly and patiently. He brought the cat down, and the neighbors clapped. The owner said Bilal was the kindest boy in the street.
story.q: Who saved the cat?

grammar.title: too / enough
grammar.explain: too تعني أكثر من اللازم بمعنى سلبي (too hot). و enough تعني كافٍ: تأتي بعد الصفة (old enough) وقبل الاسم (enough time).
examples: The tea is too hot to drink.
She is old enough to drive.
grammar.q: He is not tall ___ to reach the shelf.

words.ex: Excuse me, where is the station?
I disagree, but I respect your opinion.

story.title: A New Neighbor
story.text: A new neighbor moves in next door, and Hassan goes to say hello. 'Welcome to the street,' he says. 'Let me introduce myself. My name is Hassan.' The neighbor smiles and says, 'Nice to meet you. Thanks for coming.' They talk for a while and agree to have tea on Friday. Hassan says goodbye and walks home happily.
story.q: When will they have tea?

grammar.title: used to للعادات الماضية
grammar.explain: نستخدم used to + الفعل للحديث عن عادة أو حالة كانت في الماضي ولم تعد موجودة الآن.
examples: I used to play football every day.
She used to live in a small village.
We didn't use to have a car.
grammar.q: He ___ live in London, but he moved last year.

words.ex: She put a lot of effort into her studies.
Learning a language is a challenge.
This job is a great opportunity.

story.title: Small Steps
story.text: Layan decided to speak English every day. At first, it was a big challenge, and she made many mistakes. But she did not stop. She put in effort, listened to stories, and recorded her voice. After three months, she noticed real progress and felt more confident. She says success comes from small steps and patience.
story.q: What does Layan say success comes from?

grammar.title: الشرط الثاني (If + past, would + verb)
grammar.explain: نستخدمه لوصف خيال أو احتمال بعيد في الحاضر أو المستقبل: If + ماضٍ بسيط، ثم would + الفعل.
examples: If I had more time, I would learn French.
If she were rich, she would travel the world.
What would you do if you won a prize?
grammar.q: If I ___ a bird, I would fly to the mountains.
